name: The Platinum Card from American Express (Canada)

localized_names.en: The Platinum Card from American Express (Canada)

apr.notes: Charge card: Due in Full balances must be paid each month. Preferred interest rate of 21.99% applies to Flexible Payment Option balances; 30% applies to delinquent Due in Full charges.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident with a Canadian credit file.

categories.label: Dining and food delivery in Canada

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points redeem through Use Points for Purchases (1,000 points = $10 on eligible purchases), travel, gift cards and 1:1 transfers to partner loyalty programs.

signup_bonus.description: 90,000 Membership Rewards points after $10,000 in purchases in the first 3 months, plus 40,000 points for a purchase between months 15 and 17 (elevated offer, up to 130,000 points).

benefits.title: $200 Annual Dining Credit
benefits.description: $200 annual dining credit at a curated list of Canadian restaurants.

benefits.title: NEXUS statement credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 CAD in statement credits for NEXUS application or renewal fees.

notes: Additional Platinum Cards cost $250 each. American Express Canada cards have no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
